titulo: DEVO v2 — Herdeiro, retrato em pose (meio corpo, ref. Persona)
prompt: Bold clean anime lineart, two-tone cel shading, high-contrast graphic poster style. Half-body portrait from mid-thigh up, plain flat medium grey background, headroom above the head. A slender aristocratic young man in three-quarter view, turned toward the viewer's left, spine straight, chin raised, looking down over his lenses with a thin one-sided smirk; his right arm raised diagonally holds a black conductor's baton with a gold tip pointing out of frame; his left hand behind his back. Ash-sand beige hair swept back, one wide white streak hooking across the far eye on the viewer's left down to the jaw, thin gold half-rim glasses, heavy-lidded olive eyes, beauty mark under the eye on the viewer's right. Wine-burgundy velvet conductor's tailcoat with black satin lapels and thin gold right-angled embroidery; tall black stand collar with gold piping; white lace jabot with a gold diamond brooch and a deep red gem; charred parchment lining with faint ruled lines; thin black gloves. Cold white spotlight from directly above, thin amethyst rim light. Palette: black #0C0C0E, burgundy #8C1D47, amethyst #8A7CC8. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
